lines.pattern: In week one, 43 of your 68 plays were distorted guitars in a wall of sound and 12 were fingerpicked nylon guitar. By week four it had turned around: 35 of your 58 plays were fingerpicked nylon guitar and 7 were the wall of sound.
lines.receipt: Week one: 43 of 68 plays wall of sound (63%), 12 of 68 nylon guitar (18%). Week four: 7 of 58 wall of sound (12%), 35 of 58 nylon guitar (60%).
offers: Did these four weeks feel settled enough that you stopped wanting the noise?
Or did so much get loud around you that you wanted your music to be the quiet part?

lines.pattern: 45 of your 251 plays were of tracks new to you, and the other 206 went to tracks you had already played. One new track, Lumen Tarry, is picking up, with 4 plays in the last week.
lines.receipt: 45 of 251 plays (18%) on new tracks, 206 of 251 on tracks already played; Lumen Tarry, 4 plays in the last week.
offers: Has the music you already know been enough, so you had no reason to go looking?
Or has there been so little room for anything new that only something like Lumen Tarry got through?
